one_liner: iPayX offers a Bearer-key REST FX audit API with OpenAPI 3.1, webhooks and an official MCP server; a free tier exists (documented as 10 audits/day per key on MCP; limits vary by page), narrow scope.
auth_notes: Static Bearer token (ipx_live_ / ipx_test_) generated in the dashboard. Some public MCP tools need no auth (IP rate-limited).
access_notes: The vendor docs state a free API-key tier issued from the dashboard, which conflicts with the agent's paid_plan.
blocker_notes: Free API keys from the dashboard are enough to build and test the 3-endpoint API (medium confidence, because the /developers page cites a $99 Developer plan). The vendor docs state a free API-key tier issued from the dashboard, which conflicts with the agent's paid_plan.
